statements.impact_statement: libexpat is in this image as a fontconfig dependency behind ngx_http_image_filter_module.so. nginx loads a dynamic module only on a load_module directive; the nginx-unprivileged alpine base ships none and docker/default.conf.template declares none, so no request reaches expat. Measured in the pinned base: the only ELF linking libexpat.so is libfontconfig.so.1.16.1, the only one linking that is libgd.so.3, and libgd is there for the image filter module.
Same unloaded path as CVE-2026-117610. This image serves static files and accepts no XML document at all, so the start tag carrying over 2^30 attributes that reaches storeAtts() has no way in.
Same unloaded path as CVE-2026-117610. The fault needs a parser reused after a large document, and nothing in the image resets a parser because nothing creates one.
Same unloaded path as CVE-2026-117610. Fontconfig's own configuration files are the only XML in the image, and they are image content rather than input.

ngx_http_xslt_filter_module.so is the only ELF in this image linking libxslt, and nginx loads a dynamic module only on a load_module directive that neither the base nor docker/default.conf.template declares.
Same unreached path as CVE-2026-125350: the unloaded nginx XSLT filter module.
Same unreached path as CVE-2026-125350: the unloaded nginx XSLT filter module.

The fault is in the brotli decoder. brotli-libs is in the alpine base as a libcurl dependency. nginx-unprivileged:alpine ships no brotli module and docker/default.conf.template enables gzip, so nothing in this image decodes brotli.
The fault is reached by an HTTP/2 upload. This image runs nginx and one entrypoint script, docker/40-api-base-url.sh, and invokes curl in neither.
